hypothesis: TRAIN-derived algebraic mechanism representations can maintain uncertainty about unknown local transition functions across a public sequence of causal interventions and transfer a certified counterfactual rule to new entity relationships and genuinely unseen nonlinear Boolean functions with lower total native work than equally TRAIN-informed exact rule-constraint baselines, without losing exact certified answers.
distinct_problem: Unlike T29 known XOR/NAND or majority/parity rules, the same hidden Boolean function is shared by every node in a case and is not disclosed to a model; the learner must infer the law's truth-table bits from masked public intervention observations. Functions outside the TRAIN polynomial family appear only in prospective DEV. No new external source recruitment.

candidate.training: Fit from PUBLIC TRAIN-only observations a family-specific salience ordering of local causal input patterns plus an exact proof-carrying algebraic normal form (ANF) rule representation over posterior consistent functions; fit no source-private topology or function labels.
candidate.inference: For each graph template, maintain exact persistent partial rule truth-table constraints across the nine observational interventions; update only changed input-pattern bits. The learned salience order determines target-first rule reconstruction and compressed ANF coefficient evaluation. Unknown bits remain explicitly unconstrained; never pretend TRAIN-known affine degree limits on unseen functions.
candidate.proof: For every source-visible graph template and every possible unknown truth-table consistent with public source, certified target answer is emitted only if all counterfactual outcomes agree. For the 3-parent family exhaustive posterior is bounded to at most 8*256=2048 worlds per case. Learned ANF representation must decode exactly to the full posterior, with bitwise equivalence certified on TRAIN.

resource_bound.budget: 8 templates x 256 laws max, 9 probes, 2 future steps, no paid API
